checks: a custom cashier with sales view/charge can bind its device without acquiring administration or kitchen permissions
offline action flags mirror the exact custom-role permissions
denied manual price and discount edits leave the ticket and its stock reservation unchanged
denied credit and inline client creation roll back the entire payment
cashier HTML contains neither other gift-card secrets nor unauthorized credit balances
a supplied gift code returns only its own customer balance and rejects another business customer
the authorized cashier can settle a supplied gift plus cash without unrelated credit permissions
a forced password change immediately invalidates monetary authority even while the old browser session is open
environment: isolated real PHP/MariaDB HTTP, custom cashier, trusted device transport
